title: tile-ai/tilelang
friendlyTitle: TileLang helps developers write fast AI hardware code
summary: TileLang is a domain-specific language for writing high-performance kernels across GPUs, CPUs and other accelerators. The project has more than 8,000 stars and continues to add hardware backends and optimization support.
friendlySummary: TileLang is a special programming language for creating fast operations on GPUs, CPUs and other AI chips.
whyItMatters: AI infrastructure engineers can express and tune low-level operations with a higher-level language instead of writing every kernel directly in vendor-specific code. It is most relevant to teams optimizing model training or inference performance.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help experienced engineers speed up model training or inference without writing every low-level operation from scratch.
